description: Synthetic recall quality fixture — 4 scenarios, 12 probes

scenarios.name: employment_supersession
scenarios.description: User changes employer from Stripe to Notion — fact must update

messages.content: Hey, I'm a backend engineer at Stripe. Just started last month.
Welcome! Stripe is a great place to work. What are you working on?
I've got a golden retriever named Biscuit and I live in NYC.
Biscuit sounds adorable! NYC is vibrant.
Big news — I just started at Notion as a PM and moved to Berlin!
Wow, both a new job and a new city! Congratulations!

probes.query: Where does this user work now?
What is the user's pet's name?
What city does the user with the dog named Biscuit live in?

scenarios.name: opinion_arc
scenarios.description: User's opinion on TypeScript evolves from positive to mixed

messages.content: I absolutely love TypeScript. It's made my code so much safer.
TypeScript has definitely improved large codebases.
TypeScript generics are getting really annoying lately. Too much boilerplate.
Yes, complex generics can be challenging.

That sounds wonderful! Dogs love morning walks.
I'm vegetarian by the way, so no meat restaurants please.
